name: The Palace Madrid
positioning: Historic 1912 landmark hotel facing the Neptune Fountain in Madrid's Golden Triangle of Art, officially The Palace, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Madrid
best_for: Art lovers who want to stay beside the Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums
Travelers drawn to a historic hotel with a long literary and artistic past

facts.text: The hotel stands within Madrid's UNESCO-listed Landscape of Light district.
The hotel sits in the Golden Triangle of Art, beside the Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums.
The hotel is next to the Barrio de las Letras, the literary quarter linked to Cervantes and Lope de Vega.
Barcelona designer Lázaro Rosa-Violán created the interiors.
Federico García Lorca, Salvador Dalí and Luis Buñuel were among those who drank at the Palace's bar.
Many rooms and suites have city views that include the Neptuno Fountain, Cortes Square and the Congress of Deputies.
The Palace Suite keeps an original fireplace, with bespoke wallpaper inspired by Surrealism.
The Cervantes Suite honors Miguel de Cervantes, with handcrafted tapestry inspired by the Retiro park.
Room wallpapers are inspired by Retiro Park and shower mosaics evoke a bird's-eye view of the Royal Botanic Gardens.
La Cúpula restaurant sits beneath a stained-glass dome and serves from breakfast onward.
Ernest Hemingway paid literary tribute to the dry martini of the hotel's 27 Club bar.
The fitness area has a sauna and a terrace-solarium, and massages, facials and body treatments are offered.

highlights.text: The wrought iron and glass dome was designed by Eduardo Ferrés i Puig in 1912 and made by the Mauméjean Brothers glass studio.
The one-bedroom Royal Suite overlooks the Neptuno Fountain and has a grand dining room, a library with bar and a chef's kitchen.
The hotel faces Madrid's Neptune Fountain and has been a city landmark since 1912.
A package with the Thyssen-Bornemisza museum includes a guided tour of the collection before opening.
The Palace was Spain's first hotel to have private toilets in every room.

considerations.text: Deluxe Guest rooms have a courtyard view.
Breakfast at La Cúpula is available for a fee.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
